title: SmartAgri UGM Team Wins Gold Award at BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology (BEST) 2026
excerpt: Bandung, June 9, 2026 – The Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) team from Universitas Gadjah Mada has achieved another proud accomplishment at the BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology (BEST) 2026, held by the Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) at The Trans Luxury Hotel, Bandung. body:
**Bandung, June 9, 2026** – The Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) team from Universitas Gadjah Mada has achieved another proud accomplishment at the _BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology_ (BEST) 2026, held by the Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) at The Trans Luxury Hotel, Bandung. With their innovation **"****_Smart UAV Technology: Remote Sensing for Precision Agriculture_****"**, the team won the _Gold Award_ after competing with various technology innovations from universities, research institutions, and other organizations.

The team, led by Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty as team chair and Fahmi Arsyad, S.T.P. as team member, prepared intensively for the competition over several days before the exhibition. Various aspects, from presentation material preparation, poster design, technology demonstration, to simulation of question-and-answer sessions with the jury panel, were thoroughly prepared under the guidance and mentorship of Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. as team supervisor.

This preparation process was an important factor that helped the team convey the innovation they developed in a more systematic and comprehensible manner to both visitors and jurors. In addition to presenting their research results, the team also made efforts to explain the impact and potential application of the technology developed to support the transformation of agriculture toward a more modern, efficient, and data-driven system.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/737-1-image-3-1030x773.webp)

Team chair Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty expressed her gratitude for the award won. According to her, this achievement is the result of the team's hard work and support from various parties involved in both the research process and competition preparation.

"Of course we are happy and very grateful. This award is an encouragement as well as a form of appreciation for all the effort, time, and hard work that the team has invested throughout the research process until we were able to participate in this competition. Additionally, the experience during the competition also provided many new insights because we were able to see various innovations and interesting ideas from other teams. While attending the conference sessions, we also gained considerable knowledge and new perspectives from researchers and participants. This experience is very valuable because it not only broadened our horizons but also motivated us to continue learning and developing better research in the future," Mutiara said.

This award is evidence that the innovation developed by SmartAgri is competitive and relevant in addressing various challenges facing agriculture in the future. This achievement also demonstrates the importance of collaboration between students, researchers, and faculty in producing research-based innovations that are not only academically excellent but also have the potential for field implementation.

Through this accomplishment, Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM hopes to continue contributing to the development of precision agriculture technology in Indonesia and expand collaboration with various parties to promote the creation of a more productive, efficient, and sustainable agricultural system.

original.body:
**Bandung, 9 Juni 2026** – Prestasi membanggakan kembali diraih oleh tim Smart Agriculture Research Center (Smartagri) Universitas Gadjah Mada dalam ajang _BRIN Exhibition on Smart Technology_ (BEST) 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) di The Trans Luxury Hotel, Bandung. Melalui inovasi **“****_Smart UAV Technology: Remote Sensing for Precision Agriculture_****”**, tim berhasil meraih _Gold Award_ setelah bersaing dengan berbagai inovasi teknologi dari perguruan tinggi, lembaga penelitian, dan institusi lainnya.

Tim yang terdiri atas Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty sebagai ketua tim dan Fahmi Arsyad, S.T.P. sebagai anggota tim ini mempersiapkan keikutsertaan dalam kompetisi secara intensif selama beberapa hari sebelum pelaksanaan pameran. Berbagai aspek, mulai dari penyusunan materi presentasi, desain poster, demonstrasi teknologi, hingga simulasi sesi tanya jawab dengan dewan juri, dipersiapkan secara matang di bawah arahan dan bimbingan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., [M.Sc](http://m.sc/). sebagai supervisor tim.

Proses persiapan tersebut menjadi salah satu faktor penting yang membantu tim dalam menyampaikan inovasi yang dikembangkan secara lebih sistematis dan mudah dipahami oleh pengunjung maupun juri. Selain menampilkan hasil penelitian, tim juga berupaya menjelaskan dampak dan potensi penerapan teknologi yang dikembangkan untuk mendukung transformasi pertanian menuju sistem yang lebih modern, efisien, dan berbasis data.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/737-1-image-3-1030x773.webp)

Ketua tim, Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty, mengungkapkan rasa syukur atas penghargaan yang berhasil diraih. Menurutnya, pencapaian tersebut merupakan hasil kerja keras tim dan dukungan dari berbagai pihak yang terlibat dalam proses penelitian maupun persiapan kompetisi.

“Pastinya kami senang dan sangat bersyukur. Penghargaan ini jadi penyemangat sekaligus bentuk apresiasi atas semua usaha, waktu, dan kerja keras yang sudah tim curahkan selama proses penelitian sampai akhirnya bisa mengikuti kompetisi ini. Selain itu, pengalaman selama kompetisi juga memberikan banyak insight baru karena kami bisa melihat berbagai inovasi dan ide menarik dari tim-tim lain. Saat mengikuti sesi konferensi, kami juga mendapat banyak pengetahuan dan perspektif baru dari para peneliti serta peserta. Pengalaman ini sangat berharga karena tidak hanya menambah wawasan, tetapi juga memotivasi kami untuk terus belajar dan mengembangkan penelitian yang lebih baik ke depannya,” ujar Mutiara.

Penghargaan ini menjadi bukti bahwa inovasi yang dikembangkan oleh SmartAgri memiliki daya saing dan relevansi dalam menjawab berbagai tantangan pertanian masa depan. Capaian tersebut juga menunjukkan pentingnya kolaborasi antara mahasiswa, peneliti, dan dosen dalam menghasilkan inovasi berbasis riset yang tidak hanya unggul secara akademik, tetapi juga memiliki potensi implementasi di lapangan.

Melalui pencapaian ini, Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM berharap dapat terus berkontribusi dalam pengembangan teknologi pertanian presisi di Indonesia serta memperluas kolaborasi dengan berbagai pihak untuk mendorong terciptanya sistem pertanian yang lebih produktif, efisien, dan berkelanjutan.
